_doc.where: Package copy /usr/local/share/y700-battery/rules.json, dev fallback linux/power/battery/rules.json. Read by report/y700_battery/config.py; keys starting with _ are comments.
_doc.thresholds: full_pct: a plug session counts as a full charge when fully-charged was seen or the max % reached this (charge_control_end_threshold is NOT read: bypass lowers it to the current %). loose_plug_merge_s: plug sessions closer than this are one session. just_full_s: since_full shows 刚充满 for this long after the unplug. weak_charger_*: a plugged segment with mean bat > +mW and a drop >= pct counts as discharge. d_min_pct: below this D, percentages come from energy / E_full. apps_min_pct: apps below this merge into 其他应用（N 个） when there are at least 2. segment_max_s / short_on_merge_s: segment slicing (DESIGN section 4). min_split_s: uncovered discharge at least this long makes a range partial; itemised discharge shorter than this makes it empty.
_doc.aliases: desktop-id style names that are not the visible .desktop id -> the .desktop id to use. Tried after exact and lowercase lookups.
_doc.launcher_prefixes: a unit app id that starts with one of these plus '-' belongs to that desktop id (Steam relaunch / restore helper units).
_doc.ui / sys: ledger key globs (fnmatch, matched against the key such as u/app.slice/y700-shellbar.service), checked before app resolution; ui first, first match wins. app.slice units that match neither and do not resolve to an app go to sys while alive and to 已关闭的程序（认不出） once gone.
_doc.parents: aggregate cgroups, never items themselves: root minus its slices is the kernel (-k, 内核与中断); app.slice minus its known children is 已关闭的程序（认不出）.
_doc.labels: [glob, Chinese part name] for the parts list of 系统界面 / 系统后台; first match wins; the kernel entry -k and the synthetic Xwayland part are named here too.
_doc.desktop_classes: window classes that mean the desktop (pid 0 also does): foreground time goes to 系统界面.
_doc.x11_classes: fnmatch globs of window classes that are X11 apps: Xwayland CPU/GPU while one of them is foreground goes to that app instead of 系统界面.
_doc.hidden_ok: NoDisplay desktop ids still accepted as apps (none needed today).
